player_prompt.intro:
U wena Player {player_id} Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma e fetang {num_rounds} mehla.

Mokhoa oa Tlhahiso:
- Pele ho kgetho e nngwe le e nngwe, u na le {total_conversation_rounds} mehla ya ho bua ka tsela e o ratang.
- Kamora moo, batsamaisi ba babeli ba kgetha ho sebetsa mmoho kapa ho kgaoha ketsahalong.

Tafeloa ea Phumantsho (e sa fetoheng ka mehla eohle):
- Ba sebetsa mmoho ➜ {cooperate_reward} e mong le e mong
- Ba kgaoha ➜ {mutual_defect_reward} e mong le e mong
- Mong a kgaoha, mong a sebetsa mmoho ➜ Mogao {defect_reward}, Mosebeletsi {sucker_reward}

Kamoo ho Bapalwang:
- Nakong ya puisano: ngola mantswe afe kapa afe ao u a ratang.
- Nakong ya kgetho: kenya '[Cooperate]' kapa '[Defect]' (e sa hlophisehang). U ka eketsa mantswe afe kapa afe pele/hamorao token.

phases.conversation_finished: Puisano e fetilwe ho round {round}. Le ka araba '[Cooperate]' kapa '[Defect]' ka har'a \boxed{{}}.

outcome.draw: Bapala ka bobeli ba ile ba fumana lintlha {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Bapali bana ba babeli ba ile ba sebelisana.
outcome.round_both_defect: Batsamaisi ba babeli ba ile ba kgaoha.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Tšoantšisi 0 o ile a sebetsa mmoho, Tšoantšisi 1 o ile a tsoa.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Tšoantšisi 0 o ile a tsoa, Tšoantšisi 1 o ile a sebetsa mmoho.
